squeeze-x-sin.alt: The graph of f(x) = x sin(1/x) for x between −0.4 and 0.4, x not 0. It wiggles faster and faster near 0 but stays between the lines y = |x| and y = −|x|. Both bounds reach 0 at x = 0, so f is squeezed to 0: its limit at 0 is 0. An open circle at the origin marks that f(0) is not defined.
